describes: The closed set of machine-checkable rejection reason codes a negative conformance vector's reject.json MAY carry in its `reason` field, alongside the required `stage` (parse|apply). A runner that checks only `stage` passes an evaluator that rejects for the wrong cause; `reason` lets a runner check why.

codes.meaning: the input does not conform to the grammar (grammar/loomground.ebnf); rejected at parse
a rack-use names a rack that is not declared; the expansion pre-pass fails at parse
a rack-use omits a binding the rack declares; the expansion pre-pass fails at parse
a cord's endpoint pairing is not one of actor→gate, gate→gate, gate→master (SPEC §5.1) — includes a human as a cord endpoint and an actor cording directly to the master
a cord, on-behalf-of binding, or declaration (including an egress obligation's `on <gate>`) names a node that is not declared in the graph
the pipe relation is not acyclic (SPEC §5.1)
the on-behalf-of relation is not acyclic — a cycle in the principal chain (SPEC §6)
an actor declares more than one on-behalf-of delegator (SPEC §6)
a guard ranges outside {kind, risk, reversibility, uncertainty, party, tags} — including a guard over `id` or `provenance` (SPEC §6)
a guard pairs a field with an operator the guard-domain vocabulary does not permit for it (e.g. `contains` on an ordered field) (vocabulary/guard-domain.json)
a declared grade (granted or required) is not a member of the active grade ladder (SPEC §6)
a delegate's granted grade is above its delegator's on the active ladder, including a graded delegate under an ungraded delegator — the no-amplification invariant applied to grade (SPEC §6)

a delegate's granted risk set over a kind at a gate is not a subset of its delegator's there, including a delegate granted where its delegator holds no grant — the no-amplification invariant (SPEC §6)
a declared risk value (gate floor, token hint) is outside low < medium < high < critical (SPEC §4)
a declared or guarded reversibility value is outside the active reversibility scale (vocabulary/reversibility.json)
a delegate's mandate is not a subset of its delegator's, including a delegate with a mandate under a mandate-less delegator — the mandate-attenuation invariant (SPEC §6)
an actor declares more than one mandate (SPEC §6)
a consignee is declared on a gate that is not terminal (SPEC §6)
a transfer's purpose set is not a subset of a consigning actor's mandate, including an unmandated consigning actor — the transfer-attenuation invariant (SPEC §6)
a transfer names a consignee no gate declares (SPEC §6)
